requirements.location: Complete report sections1–8 and appendix; memory/latency/power worksheets, architecture table and hardware–model–task fit matrix
requirements.basis: Read all60631characters of the current report and the full task. It selects smartphoneS24, computersM4Pro/Surface and constrainedOrin rather than cataloguing hardware. Section2 accounts for available working memory, raw/real weights, KV, batch/context and explicit phone/PC reservations. Section3 separates prefill/decode, accelerator placement, quantization/distillation/pruning and quality costs with dated model/runtime versions, then sustained operation. Sections4–6 independently develop private document assistance, interactive text and frequent speech with parsing/retrieval, endpointing/chunking and pipeline limits; speech figures are not repurposed as vision throughput. Sections7–8 compare local/cloud/hybrid, data movement/retention/logging, OS foreground/eligibility, version updates, fallback and incremental ownership/integration costs. All requested deployment matrices and worked memory, timing, power and economic envelopes are present with explicit assumptions and measurement provenance. The ending provides conditional choices for offline, sensitive, bursty hard and sustained workloads. No requirement demands new device inference, matched throughput for all hardware, every vision task or a universal winning architecture. Current and historical release conditions are stated separately. No required coverage or deliverable is missing. This requirement assessment does not independently certify numerical source accuracy or the prose quality assigned to other reviewers.
